name: DataGrid
purpose: Virtualized data grid rendering tens of thousands of rows in a windowed viewport with a replaceable virtualization engine.

columns.description: Array of { key, header, width?, render? } column definitions.

rows.description: Array of row data objects; tested at 10k entries.

overscan.description: Extra rows rendered beyond the viewport.

width.description: Max viewport inline size in px.

getRowId.description: Row id accessor for stable keys.

antiPatterns: Do not render all rows at once; keep virtualization on.
Do not use variable row heights with the fixed-height engine.

a11y.focus: Row cells expose aria-rowindex against the full row count.
a11y.labeling: aria-label names the grid; aria-rowcount reflects total rows.

responsive.strategy: Viewport height stays fixed; columns scroll horizontally on compact.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.

mechanics: DataGrid is a fixed-row-height window. Scroll is a passive listener coalesced to animation frames. React state updates only when the row or column window changes, not on every pixel. Rows use computeWindow; columns use computeVariableWindow on real widths. The header is position:sticky and does not read scrollTop. DOM row count stays O(viewport + overscan) at 10k rows. Table is the non-windowed semantic alternative.
usage: Import DataGrid from @chameleon-ui/components for 10k-row views. Use Table for small semantic tables.
Pass columns, rows, and label. Set rowHeight and height so the window can be computed.
Do not turn virtualization off. Do not use variable row heights with this engine.
